design.episode_attempt_policy: Five target seeds per selector; infrastructure failures are preserved and retried as separate attempts.
design.runner_mode: autonomous flag retained from superseded attempt: disables runtime feedback and stuck recovery
design.episode_termination: natural scenario terminal or provider/runner error; no action or wall-clock episode limit
design.provider_session_id: not recorded; kept in local configuration
design.recovery_timeout_reason: Three instrumented requests hit APITimeoutError/ReadTimeout with the original 30-second timeout; retries use 120 seconds per request, no episode step or wall-clock limit.
